Sam (People Ops): Quick update: we've shortened the SOC2 evidence upload window by 48 hours due to auditor schedule change. New cutoff is Thu Apr 10 18:00 PT. Apologies for the short notice — please escalate blockers now. :sweat_smile: 
Maya (Security): Important: that applies to all teams in the evidence repo (soc2-2026/*). If you already uploaded, no action needed. If not, prioritize config + short context note.
Devon (Data): FYI — for embedding data retention proof, do we need schema + sample queries or full dataset export?
Maya (Security): Schema + sample queries + access controls screenshot should be sufficient. No need for full exports.
Priya (ML): I'm out tomorrow. Can I ask someone to upload my model eval logs? What metadata do you need?
Sam (People Ops): Managers may upload on behalf of folks who are OOO. Include the owner's name, approver (manager), and expected return date in a short metadata.txt.
Nia (Eng): Small note for infra owners: if you have rolling logs, include a 1-line statement of retention policy and a small extract of logs that shows rotation. That satisfies the auditor's ask.
Devon (Data): Upload syntax for those using aws cli: 
```
aws s3 cp reports/soc2/* s3://redwood-evidence/soc2-2026/data/ --acl private
```
Sam (People Ops): Office hours today 16:00 PT with Maya and Priya for triage. Quick 20-min slots; sign-up: https://cal.link/redwood-evidence-qa :calendar: 
compliance-bot: Auto-summary: 7 teams uploaded, 6 teams pending. Next reminder scheduled in 6 hours.
Maya (Security): If any team needs an exception because of a legal freeze or deploy freeze, file an exception form (link in repo) and CC security. We'll triage.
Priya (ML): Thanks — I'll DM my manager to schedule the upload.
Sam (People Ops): Thanks all. We'll run a sweep at 18:15 PT and ping any remaining owners. :rocket:
